invariants.rationale: metaClient is a required parameter and likely must be non-null to interact with table metadata.
columnsToIndex should be non-null so the method can work with a defined set of columns.
If columnsToIndex is non-null and non-empty, its first element should not be null.
If columnsToIndex is non-null, it is likely meant to contain only non-null column names.
A valid List in Java always has a non-negative size; this checks for a consistent list state if columnsToIndex is not null.
